pages.text: FEBRUARY 2000 MIDWAY 16- 11108 39” STATIONARY AND 39” MOTION DEDIGATED VIDEO GAME MANUAL AMENDMENT Please Be Informed... That additional grounding has been added to the 39” stationary and 39” motion Dedicated Cruis’n Exotica™ game cabinet. This amendment contains revised installation instructions to reflect this change. REVISED INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS Use the following instructions to supplement the game set-up instructions outlined in the Operator’s Manual. For complete Set-Up Instructions refer to the Operations section in the Operator's Manual for your dedicated video game machine. 1. After performing caster and leveler installation as outlined in the Operator's Manual, locate the 8/32x 1%” screw in the pass through opening in the main cabinet. 2. Install a washer and locking nut on the screw and tighten in place. Install the lug from the ground braid onto the screw followed by a wing nut and tighten in place. 3. Proceed to assemble the game cabinet in the order described in the Operator’s Manual. MIDWAY AMUSEMENT GAMES, LLC. Page 1 of 1
